Who I am

I’m a network and wireless professional with hands-on experience supporting ISP infrastructure, managing wireless access points, troubleshooting connectivity, and improving repeatable operations through automation.

My work spans MikroTik routing, PPPoE environments, monitoring, customer-impact troubleshooting, and coordinating network operations across multiple sites. I enjoy turning recurring technical tasks into reliable processes and making connectivity more stable for the people who depend on it.

What I value

Reliable service, clear communication, continuous learning, and solutions that can be maintained by the team—not just built once.
